facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary PFS endpoint; financing and strategic alternatives explored · Phase 3 · selinexor in endometrial cancer · on market
facts.indication: TP53 wild-type advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer

evidence.summary: The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of progression free survival (“PFS”).
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of progression free survival (“PFS”).
evidence.safety: The safety and tolerability profile of selinexor was consistent with its established safety profile, with no new safety signals observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: The results of the XPORT-EC-042 trial do not affect ongoing trials of selinexor in other potential indications.
